title: Refund policy (RAG)
prompt: What is our refund policy for annual plans?
description: Retrieval from the docs store; the matching snippet is injected into the prompt and cited.

turns.say: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase [03-refunds]. After 30 days you get a pro rata refund for the unused full months, minus a 10% processing fee, paid back to the original payment method within 10 business days [03-refunds].
